senses.gloss: नख- + अग्र नख- + अग्र, n. the tip of the nails, Man. 2, 167.
नख- + कुलिश नख- + कुलिश, thunderbolt-like nails, Pañc. 16, 4.
† नख् नख्, i. 4 and i. 1, Par., and नङ्ख् नङ्ख्, i. 1, Par. To go.

नख नख,
 I. m. and n. A nail of a finger or of a toe, Man. 4, 35.
 II. n. and f. खी, A certain perfume.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. O.H.G. nagal; A.S. naegel; ὄνυξ, ὀνύχιον; Lat. ungula.

नखर नख + र,
 I. adj. Shaped like a claw, MBh. 6, 693.
 II. (m. or n.),
 1. A knife, 7, 1318.
 2. A fingernail, a claw, Caurap. 15; Pañc. 91, 5.
नखानखि नखानखि, i. e. नख-नख + इ, adv. Scratching one another, MBh. 8, 2377.
नखायुधत्व नखायुध + त्व, i. e. नख-आयुध + त्व, n. Being a beast using its nails or claws as its weapon, Pañc. 71, 11.
नखिन् नखिन्, i. e. नख + इन्, m. A beast with nails or claws, Cāṇ. 27.
नख- + विष्किर नख- + विष्किर, m. a bird wounding with strong talons, a bird of prey, Man. 5, 13.
